共同操作

A1

步骤 1：Combine 1a, organic azide 2, CuTc, and solvent; stir.；步骤 2：Add the second-stage catalyst/additive and continue the reaction.

A2

加料顺序：2a into 1/CuTc/toluene；H2O；TsOH；通法出处：General Procedure for the Preparation of Compounds 4；操作记录：Tosyl azide was added to allenyne/CuTc in toluene; rt 12 h; H2O then TsOH; TLC; NaHCO3 quench; EtOAc extraction; concentration; flash chromatography.；步骤 1：Add tosyl azide to a solution of the 1,6-allenyne and CuTc in toluene; stir.；步骤 2：Successively add H2O and TsOH and continue until TLC completion.；步骤 3：Quench with saturated aqueous NaHCO3 and extract with EtOAc.；步骤 4：Concentrate the combined organic phase under reduced pressure.；步骤 5：Flash chromatography on silica gel with hexanes/EtOAc/DCM eluent.

A3

步骤 1：Add tosyl azide to a solution of the 1,6-allenyne and CuTc in toluene; stir.；步骤 2：Add SiO2 and continue the comparison reaction.

A4

步骤 1：CuTc-catalyzed CuAAC reaction in toluene.

A5

步骤 1：Treat isolated triazole with TsOH in toluene.

A6

步骤 1：Hydrogenate under an H2 balloon with Pd/C in IPA.
